drafted_from: tool:edit-saved-page's row in tools/keep-links-i-saved-elsewhere-such/tool-rows.json, do-work/saved-pages.mjs and test/saved-pages-tools.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Refresh this saved page every N hours" or change its title. It runs tool:edit-saved-page and answers what it made.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: each saved page is a file in the person's Files, with one index file the tools keep in step.
instructions: 1. Say what to save or read: an http or https address of a web page, or the key the saved page answered with.
2. Say to your AI: "Change the saved page https://example.com/a to refresh every 6 hours." It calls tool:edit-saved-page at @tools with the input.
3. Read the answer, or the reason it was refused: a page with no text is not saved, and a link no provider handles names the ones it knows.
